arabic text: ZAINAB LIPAT KE ROI, ABBAS KEY NISHAN SE
english translation text: ZAINAB HELD THE ALAM OF ABBAS AND WEPT

arabic text: ZAINAB LIPAT KE ROI, ABBAS KEY NISHAAN SE\nAISA GHAYUR BHAIYA, LAAUNGI PHIR KAHAN SE
english translation text: ZAINAB HELD THE ALAM OF ABBAS AND WEPT,\nWHERE WILL I FIND SUCH AN HONOURABLE BROTHER AGAIN

arabic text: EK BAAR TUM CHACHA JAAN, KHAIMO MEI LOUT AAWO\nSHIKWA NA PHIR SUNOGE, PAANI KA IS ZUBAAN SE,\nAISA GHAYUR BHAIYA, LAAUNGI PHIR KAHAN SE
english translation text: UNCLE ABBAS, PLEASE RETURN TO THE TENTS JUST ONCE MORE,\nYOU WILL NOT HEAR A SINGLE COMPLAINT OR MENTION ABOUT WATER AGAIN\nWHERE WILL I FIND SUCH AN HONOURABLE BROTHER AGAIN

arabic text: SHER ALI KA LAASHA, SHABBIR LEKE AAYE\nDHUNDHEGI AB SAKINA, BAZOO KAHAAN SE,\nAISA GHAYUR BHAIYA, LAAUNGI PHIR KAHAN SE
english translation text: SHABBIR (A.S.) HAS BROUGHT THE BODY OF ABBAS,\nWHERE WILL SAKINA LOOK FOR HIS ARMS,\nWHERE WILL I FIND SUCH AN HONOURABLE BROTHER AGAIN

arabic text: BHULE NAHI ZAMANA, TASEER-E-BINTE ZEHRA\nGHAIRAT TARAP RAHI THI ABBAS KEY NISHAA SE\nAISA GHAYUR BHAIYA, LAAUNGI PHIR KAHAN SE
english translation text: WE SHOULD NOT FORGET THE IMPACT THAT THE DAUGHTER OF ZAHRA (S.A.) HAD,\nHONOUR HERSELF WAS WEEPING AT THE ALAM OF ABBAS,\nWHERE WILL I FIND SUCH AN HONOURABLE BROTHER AGAIN

arabic text: QAMARE ALI KA LAASHA, US WAQT TARAP GAYAA THA\nBANDHA JO ZAALIMO NEY, ZAINAB KO RISMAA SE\nAISA GHAYUR BHAIYA, LAAUNGI PHIR KAHAN SE
english translation text: THE BODY OF ABBAS TREMBLED WHEN THE ENEMIES TIED ZAINAB’S HANDS WITH ROPES,\nWHERE WILL I FIND SUCH AN HONOURABLE BROTHER AGAIN
